notes.title: FRAMED Collection 80% off in the Fellow Traveller Publisher Sale!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31028674/fbf6e661234a81ccb6ae7364c30b97881e9ef52d.png

The annual Fellow Traveller Publisher Sale is now on - and to celebrate, FRAMED Collection is 80% off! 

➡️ Take me to the Publisher Sale ⬅️

There are plenty more Fellow Traveller titles on sale to choose from - so whether you're looking for something new, a bargain, some cool soundtracks and bundles, or even something to play on Steam Deck, we're sure to have something just for you.

We're also thrilled to announce that three new games are joining the Fellow Traveller family; Scrabdackle, Wander Stars and Kulebra and the Souls of Limbo - read up on each of them below!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32967820/40c1797b8a73e5d9ffe2140b51ffa845f73fec0e.gif

 Wander Stars: Follow the story of Ringo and Wolfe as they join forces to collect the pieces of the Wanderstar Map in this turn-based RPG with roguelite elements! Use words to create your own fighting techniques, befriend your rivals, and explore the universe in an adventure inspired by 90s anime.
 Scrabdackle: As a novice wizard, discover the intricate world of Scrabdackle and experience the impact wizardkind has unknowingly had upon it. Scrabdackle is a hand-drawn, non-linear adventure with a vast, intricate overworld, tight and responsive combat, cheeky banter, and pages of lore to discover.
 Kulebra and the Souls of Limbo: A 3D adventure where you play as Kulebra, a dead snake with a heart of gold that wakes up in Limbo. Use your wits and keen eye to gather clues from the residents and find items that will help uncover the mystery of Limbo and its curse that traps souls into repeating the same day on loop.So get exploring and grab some great narrative games!

notes.title: WE ARE LIVE! FRAMED Collection is out now!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31028674/4e8842b22f351d7eb2c3b5377c7b5517566b34fd.jpg

Hi there,

We’re so excited that FRAMED Collection has finally launched on Steam (PC, Mac and Linux versions). We’ve been working so hard behind the scenes to make everything right, and to get ready to share our games and world of FRAMED with you.

If you love clever, unique puzzle games, spy adventures, noir aesthetics and jazz fusion soundtracks, then you’ll love FRAMED Collection.

Of course, if you’re reading this because you’ve already bought and played the game, we’d love to hear what you think of it. Be sure to come back and post your thoughts, GIFs, questions and user reviews in the Community Hub; we love hearing from our fans.

You can also find us on Twitter @loveshackers.

Once again, it means a great deal to us to launch FRAMED Collection: we can finally share our creative dreams and labours with you, the fans. Thank you so much for your enthusiasm and support of FRAMED Collection. It means the world to us.

- Loveshack Devs

notes.title: FRAMED Collection gets a release date!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31028674/a7021093b31a4a891e6e91ca355efff5a4d6aad7.jpg

Hi there, and welcome to our FRAMED Collection community!

We’re very happy to finally announce the release date of May 17 for FRAMED Collection on Steam (PC, Mac and Linux versions). If you love clever, unique puzzle games, spy adventures, noir aesthetics and jazz fusion soundtracks, then be sure to wishlist the game! If you do that, we’ll also be able to let you know about any great ‘launch week’ deals.

Of course, once the game has released, we’d love to hear what you think of it. Be sure to come back and post your thoughts, GIFs, questions and user reviews in the Community Hub; we love hearing from our fans. If you’re on Twitter, come and say, ‘Hey,’ by tweeting @loveshackers.

We’ll post again soon, around the launch of the game. Until then, thanks for checking out FRAMED Collection.

- Loveshack Devs
